notes.text: CODE-LED BUILD. Direction round returned buildPath=code, buildPathFlipped=false. Image generation is unavailable this session: no harness-native image tool, and generate-image.mjs reports OPENAI_API_KEY unset. Per new-work.md, with no image generation code-led is the only path and no comp is owed; the comp-led phase gates (comps/spec/plates/hero) therefore do not apply to this run. Ambition lives in the direction contract's FIRST VIEWPORT block and named signature interaction, to be audited in behavior by the finish reviewer. No approved comp exists and no decision comp was generated, so the finish reviewer's comp slot is empty by contract, not by omission.

reasons: 0 comps under .impeccable/mocks; the comp round puts three compositional options of the chosen direction in front of the user (reference/visualize.md). Generate the missing ones (harness image tool or generate-image.mjs), each with a .json sidecar holding its prompt.

no comp is approved: put the three comps in front of the user (decision page via serve-question.mjs, or the structured question tool), then set "approved": true in the chosen comp's sidecar. A delegated pick is recorded the same way and disclosed.
